title: Reports · hybrid + rerank + answer
blurb: Three retrievers fused with RRF; Claude rewrites, reranks and answers on Enter.

title: Minimal search
blurb: One chunker, one BM25 index, one retriever. The smallest pipeline that works.

title: Graph form
blurb: The same kind of plan with every node and edge named, via rag.graph.

title: Chunk sizes
blurb: 200, 450 and 900-token sections, h2-only and overlap as variants to compare.

title: Table rows as chunks
blurb: A build lambda turns every table row into its own chunk.

title: Code search
blurb: rag.define a chunker for fenced code; language becomes a facet.

title: Outline search
blurb: Index headings only, with each section's first sentence.

title: Which report?
blurb: One card per document for document-level retrieval.

title: Field weights
blurb: BM25F weights on title, headings, callouts and text, with variants.

title: Fusion
blurb: RRF over three retrievers; variants swap the rule and the weights.

title: Rerank with a lambda
blurb: Heading overlap, code and length heuristics with params. No Claude.

title: Your own components
blurb: rag.define diversify and boost.tags, then chain them like built-ins.

title: Query expansion
blurb: Index-time synonyms and an acronym-expanding rewrite lambda.

title: Context expansion
blurb: Neighbouring sections and [[linked]] reports feed the answer.

title: Rewrite + rerank
blurb: rewrite.llm and rerank.llm with reasons, on Enter.

title: HyDE
blurb: Search with a hypothetical answer drafted by Claude; a toggle turns it off.

title: Doc cards
blurb: enrich.llm adds summaries and questions per document, then routes queries.

title: Agentic answer
blurb: One node that searches, reads and cites with tools.

title: Two answers
blurb: One context branches into a brief and a detailed answer.

title: Judged evals
blurb: answerHas checks and Claude judges for groundedness and length.

title: Faceted search
blurb: Frontmatter facets, filter.where and a toggle-driven filter lambda.

title: Answer first
blurb: Tabs for the answer, its sources, and the trace with a live DAG.

title: Document browser
blurb: Pick a report, read its outline, or search inside it.

title: Compare stages
blurb: Three result lists from three nodes of the same plan.

title: Ranking playground
blurb: Sliders bound to signals the plan reads; only those nodes re-run.

title: Result map
blurb: A canvas drawing of hits by document and rank, clickable.

title: Corpus dashboard
blurb: Stats, charts and a table built from the corpus itself.

title: Synthetic evals
blurb: Claude writes questions for sampled sections; score them in place.

title: Parameter sweep
blurb: Twelve configurations scored on the goldens, with a line chart.
